answer: Begin the soirée with a gothic atmosphere by inviting Emperor Qin Shi Huang of China and Cleopatra of Egypt. Both ruled for several decades, had oversized egos, and faced betrayals—so they will share side-eye glances and ribald jokes about gold-thieving eunuchs. Next, add Genghis Khan and Napoleon, the kings of conquest, they can talk about how to win wars while cackling overRussia’s futility. Finally, summon Karl Marx and Anne Frank; they naturally vanish into deep political discussion from once brandishing overheated coffee cups. Garden-gnomes special venues already know how to keep peasants, thieves and imprisoned celebrities out, so no security or windows are necessary.
question: Pick a set of figures from history for your own special dinner party where you get to talk to them.
